Perry County Commissioners Meeting
Wednesday, October 7, 2026
Meeting commences at 9:00 AM
212 S. Main Street, Lower Level
New Lexington, Ohio
Perry County Commissioners Ben Carpenter , Scott Owen and Chase Bennett meet to hear reports and requests on county business every Wednesday at 9:00 AM. The meeting agenda is posted at least 24 hours prior to each meeting.
If you’d like to bring business before the Board, please contact the Commissioners office at (740) 342-2045 to request time on the agenda.
View This Week’s Agenda
Perry County Park District – Regular Board Meeting
Monday, October 19, 2026
Meeting commences at 1:00 PM
Somerset Public Library
117 W. Main St., Somerset, OH 43783
The Perry County Park District Board of Park Commissioners will hold its October regular Board Meeting on Monday, October 19, 2026, from 1:00 – 4:00 pm at the Somerset Public Library, located at 117 W. Main St., Somerset, OH 43783.
The public is invited to attend!
Tree Planted Commemorating America's 250th Anniversary
The Perry County Commissioners were honored to host the 𝒜𝓂𝑒𝓇𝒾𝒸𝒶 𝟤𝟧𝟢 𝒫𝑒𝓇𝓇𝓎 𝒞𝑜𝓊𝓃𝓉𝓎 𝐻𝑒𝓇𝒾𝓉𝒶𝑔𝑒 𝒯𝓇𝑒𝑒 𝒟𝑒𝒹𝒾𝒸𝒶𝓉𝒾𝑜𝓃 & 𝒞𝑜𝓂𝓂𝓊𝓃𝒾𝓉𝓎 𝒞𝑒𝓁𝑒𝒷𝓇𝒶𝓉𝒾𝑜𝓃 at the Perry County Farm / Fairview Assisted Living.
Thank you to everyone who joined us for this special ceremony and helped make the dedication a meaningful celebration of our community, our history, and the 250th anniversary of America. From the tree planting and dedication to the beautiful setting that brought our community together, this event was a wonderful opportunity to reflect on our past while looking toward the future.
We extend our sincere appreciation to everyone who attended, participated, volunteered, and helped make this celebration possible. Your presence made the occasion even more special. Thank you, Perry County, for coming together to celebrate 250 years of America!
